ctx.x: Oh, uh, Blue was on. Fasola, Fasola, yeah. Blue Pristotnik and Irving Fasola were both here.

Fasola was on for a couple of years. Yeah. Let's see. In fact, when he first came down, he replaced the kind of band. And I wondered why they even put him on. I didn't think he was that good. You didn't think Fasola was that good? No. He went out to get a boy, a regular boy was sick, and Dan had Fasola come down. We didn't like him too much. We didn't think he didn't fit in with the band very well. But later on, he was also really good. I don't want to develop, but I guess it was at the time we didn't realize…
He certainly had a beautiful tone. Oh, yes.
